findings.reason: The design round's D1 MAJOR (remediated in 5ffc6a5a78) shortened this chip to hold the pinned four-chip sample to two rows at the 550px floor, and that fit constraint stands. The approved short form still says access *to* the phone («к телефону»), while the feature and the locale's own tip (ui.chat.composer.tip.phone_access: «попросите доступ с телефона…») mean access *from* the phone; es and vi also render 'from' (desde / từ), and all six other locales keep the 'turn on' verb. The proposed «Доступ с телефона» is one character longer than the current chip and remains far inside the row budget the D1 fix freed, so it does not reopen the three-row defect.
